workstream: P5 / AC1027 TABLECONTENT double border and spacing override

basis.authoritativeSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4.

specFields.doubleLineSpacingOverride: property bit 0x20; BD in DXF group 40
specFields.wireOrder: edge flags, property override flags, border type, color, lineweight, linetype handle, invisibility, double-line spacing

consumerReference.supports: AutoCAD exposes double-line spacing as a border property and documents a default of 0.1800; it does not document a complete numeric validity range. This slice therefore qualifies only the tested finite positive profile.

profile.fixture: Runtime-authored 2x2 TABLECONTENT based on tableContentScalarGrid; no drawing fixture files were added.
coverage: Double border type 2 with the explicit spacing override bit
Spacing 0.5 carried in group 40 and combined with indexed color and visibility
One-hot and grouped disjoint edge masks
ASCII and binary physical wire checks and fresh typed readback
profile.unsupportedCompanions: Linetype handles, extended CMC/name/book colors, overlapping edge declarations, and unqualified type/spacing combinations remain refused.

implementation.behavior: The bounded TABLECONTENT cell-border writer admits Double=2 only when the spacing override bit is set and spacing is finite and positive. Single=1 remains limited to no spacing override and zero spacing; unselected type/spacing fields must retain model defaults.
implementation.physicalWire: The scalar wire walk checks ordered edge masks, property masks, group-91 Double type, indexed color, lineweight, null linetype, visibility, group-40 spacing, and closing markers.
implementation.typedReadback: Fresh ASCII and binary imports preserve edge masks, property masks, Double type, indexed color, lineweight, visibility and exact spacing.
implementation.failureRetry: Negative spacing and unsupported property masks refuse without replacing the destination sentinel or changing the caller value. After restoring the model, the same adapter successfully retries; fresh readback compares every border field, including spacing.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All inputs are generated at runtime; no external drawing fixtures were added.

limits: Only the AC1027 TABLECONTENT serializer/readback profile is covered; this is not DWG TABLECONTENT output or other DXF version qualification.
The receipt does not establish the full numeric validity domain for spacing or native CAD rendering.
Wire and typed readback do not establish producer completeness, whole-document closure, or public support claims.
next: Continue with source- or consumer-backed linetype, extended-color, and non-overlapping edge profiles; keep unsupported combinations refused.
